source_text: The Constitution of India describes India as a Union of States. Parliament may by law form new States and alter the areas, boundaries or names of existing States under Article 3.

canned.question: Under which Article can Parliament form new States?
canned.source_quote: Parliament may by law form new States and alter the areas, boundaries or names of existing States under Article 3
canned.explanation: Article 3 empowers Parliament to form new States.
